name: Denel G6 Rhino
protection: Welded steel, protects against small arms and shell fragments, mine-resistant hull. Game rule: immune to small-calibre (5.56/5.45/7.62x39/7.62x51); 7.62x54R AP and 12.7/14.5 mm can penetrate side/rear and disable tyres, engine and optics; every launcher in the game list penetrates.
visual_notes: Large 6x6 wheeled hull with 3 evenly spaced axles
Sharply wedged front with driver centred, engine behind
Big boxy turret at the rear with long 155 mm barrel
